summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice in its Sporting Notes that Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, offered free concerts every evening at 619 Market Street with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, December 20, 1890, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen, billed as retired champion pugilist of the world, ran a concert saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with free concerts every evening
